	from collections import defaultdict
	dataByHour = defaultdict(list)
	for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(value):
		dataByHour[row['hourTimeStamp']].append(row)
	
	seriesOEE = []
	seriesA = []
	seriesP = []
	seriesQ = []
	for tStamp, rows in sorted(dataByHour.items()):
		totalWeight = 0.0
		weightedAVal = 0.0
		weightedPVal = 0.0
		weightedQVal = 0.0
		weightedOEEVal = 0.0
		formattedTStamp = system.date.format(system.date.addMinutes(tStamp, offsetMins), dateFormat)
		
		for row in rows:
			duration = row['durationSecs'] or 0.0
			if duration <= 0: continue
	
			aVal = float(row['availability'] or 0)
			pVal = float(row['performance'] or 0)
			qVal = float(row['quality'] or 0)
			oeeVal = aVal * pVal * qVal

			weightedAVal += aVal * duration
			weightedPVal += pVal * duration
			weightedQVal += qVal * duration
			weightedOEEVal += oeeVal * duration
			totalWeight += duration
	
		seriesA.append({'x': formattedTStamp, 'y': weightedAVal / totalWeight if totalWeight > 0 else None})
		seriesP.append({'x': formattedTStamp, 'y': weightedPVal / totalWeight if totalWeight > 0 else None})
		seriesQ.append({'x': formattedTStamp, 'y': weightedQVal / totalWeight if totalWeight > 0 else None})
		seriesOEE.append({'x': formattedTStamp, 'y': weightedOEEVal / totalWeight if totalWeight > 0 else None})
	
	series = []
	
	if oeeMetric in ('oee', 'all'): series.append({'name': 'OEE', 'data': seriesOEE})
	if oeeMetric in ('availability', 'all'): series.append({'name': 'Availability', 'data': seriesA})
	if oeeMetric in ('performance', 'all'): series.append({'name': 'Performance', 'data': seriesP})
	if oeeMetric in ('quality', 'all'): series.append({'name': 'Quality', 'data': seriesQ})
		
	return series
